select IFNULL(fp.finprod_market_id, fp.finprod_id) as assetId, IFNULL(fp.finprod_abbr, fp.finprod_name) as assetName, fp.finprod_type as finprodType, fp.finprod_id as originalFinprodId from fin_product_type fpt inner join fin_product fp on fp.finprod_id = fpt.finprod_id where fpt.type_3 is not null
union all
select ftp.finprod_id as assetId, ftp.finprod_id as assetName, ftp.finprod_type as finprodType, ftp.finprod_id as originalFinprodId from fin_product_type fpt inner join fin_trade_product ftp on ftp.finprod_id = fpt.finprod_id where fpt.type_3 is not null and ftp.branch = '0'
)
AND ( assetId like concat_ws('','%',#{search},'%') OR assetName like concat_ws('','%',#{search},'%') )
